verdict.rationale: cubic.yaml (the config defining review behavior and custom agents) lives in the repo root, so it inherits git's native versioning and can be reviewed like any code change (cubic-docs-16, cubic-docs-11), but there is no dedicated changelog, rollback UI, or history feature specifically for cubic's automations/config themselves. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/version-history feature for automation configs, evidence of reviewing changes to cubic.yaml itself, dedicated UI for managing automation versions.
